name: Fey-Touched Great Wolf
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-99: Blessings of the Forest

offensiveAbilities.name: Sudden Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The great wolf Strides twice and makes a melee Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tickle Bite
offensiveAbilities.description: The fey-touched great wolf makes a jaws Strike. If successful, after taking the normal damage from the Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save or become Slowed 1 for 1 minute as it becomes overcome with fits of laughter.

offensiveAbilities.name: Topiary
offensiveAbilities.description: Until the next time it acts, the fey-touched great wolf appears to be a topiary in the shape of a wolf. It has an automatic result of 37 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as a bush.

offensiveAbilities.name: Worry
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The great wolf has a creature Grabbed with its jaws

Effect The great wolf shakes the grabbed creature with its teeth, dealing (2d8+4) Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
